question: A glass rod has a charge of $+3.2 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. Justify whether this value of charge is physically possible. Give reason.

options.A: No; $3.2 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ is not an integral multiple of $e$
options.B: No; positive charge cannot exist on a glass rod
options.C: Yes; it represents the removal of one electron only
